latex.I_thm_main: For every $\alpha>0$ and every bounded Borel $f$, $\lim_N \mathbb E p_N(f)=\mathcal P_f(\alpha):=\inf_{q\in\mathcal Q}\{\alpha V_f(q)+S_{\mathrm I}(q)\}$. Moreover $p_N(f)\to\mathcal P_f(\alpha)$ in probability. The variational value is finite.
latex.S_thm_main: For every $\alpha,\beta>0$ and every $\phi\in C_b(\R;\R)$, $\lim_N\E p_N=\inf_{m\in\U}\{\alpha V_{\beta\phi}(m)+S(m)\}=:\mathcal P(\alpha,\beta,\phi)$, $p_N\to\mathcal P$ in probability; $S(m)=\frac12\int_0^1(1/D_m(t)-1/(1-t))dt$, $V_f(m)=\sup_v\E_B[f(B_1+\int_0^1 m v)-\frac12\int m v^2]$.
latex.B_thm_main: Bi-orthogonally invariant $A_N$ ($M=\lfloor\alpha N\rfloor$), singular-value ESD $\Rightarrow\nu$ compact with no outliers, $f\in C_b$: $F_N(A_N,f)\to F_{\alpha,\nu}(f)$ in probability and mean, given as the mesh limit of $\sup_{\rho}\{\frac12\sum v_i\log(\rho_i/v_i)+\alpha P^f_p((s_j^2\rho_j/\alpha)_j)\}$ with angular pressure $P_p^f$ evaluated by nested limits $\lambda\to\infty,B\to\infty,\theta\downarrow0$ of a matrix-path Parisi-type functional (eq:angularformula, paper.tex:221).
latex.J_thm_main: There exist $\alpha_c\in(0,\infty)$, $\eps_0\in(0,1)$ such that for coordinate law $\nu_\eps=\frac12N(0,1-\eps)+\frac12N(0,1+\eps)$, $\eps\in[0,\eps_0)$: (i) SAT w.p.$\to1$ for $\alpha<\alpha_c$, $\to0$ for $\alpha>\alpha_c$; (ii) ordered limits $\lim_{\alpha\downarrow\alpha_c}\lim_{\beta\to\infty}\lim_N$ of gap and force laws exist, independent of $\eps$; (iii) $G_J(u)=u^{1-\gamma+o(1)}$, $F_J(s)=s^{1+\theta+o(1)}$, $\gamma=1/(2+\theta)$, $0.4126930<\gamma<0.4126934$, $0.4231063<\theta<0.4231088$ (margin $-1$, quadratic penalty $V(z)=\frac12(-1-z)_+^2$).

main_statement.paraphrase: A family of four model-produced papers on random perceptrons. The two core papers prove a full-RSB (Parisi-type) variational formula for the limiting quenched pressure at EVERY positive density and temperature, for arbitrary bounded potentials (Ising: bounded Borel; spherical: bounded continuous) with Gaussian patterns -- previously known only at small density (Talagrand; Bolthausen-Nakajima-Sun-Xu) or as non-rigorous replica predictions (Gyorgyi-Reimann 2000; Montanari-Zhou 2024). The third extends the spherical formula to bi-orthogonally invariant disorder with compact no-outlier spectrum. The fourth proves a sharp SAT threshold at margin -1 (quadratic penalty) and the Franz-Parisi/CKPUZ jamming exponents of gap and force laws in a prescribed order of limits, with a computer-assisted (interval arithmetic) certificate for the exponent enclosure, and universality for small Gaussian-scale-mixture coordinates.

Junk-value checks: controlValue is sSup of a set that is nonempty (v=0) and bounded by ||f||, so no junk; ENNReal truncated subtraction harmless because D_m(t) ≤ 1-t makes the integrand nonnegative; Bochner drift ∫ m v is a.s. integrable when cost finite. (3) IsingFiniteness is only the finiteness clause of I Thm main for bounded CONTINUOUS f (paper: 'The variational value is finite', model.tex:96; proved in two lines from S_I>=0, S_I(0)=0, |V_f|<=||f|| at model.tex:101-107 and var:step-reduction).
main_statement.formalized_vs_claimed: Formalized (if comparators compile): the full spherical-perceptron free-energy theorem (S Thm 1) and its spherical dual formula; for the Ising paper only the elementary finiteness of the variational value (the Lean proves |patternFunctional| ≤ K via convergence of uniform-grid recursions, entropy ≥ 0 and entropy(0)=0). NOT formalized: Ising Thm main (limit of E p_N, convergence in probability, bounded Borel extension, integrable activations, random-sign universality); the entire bi-orthogonally invariant paper; the entire jamming paper (threshold, gap/force laws, exponents, certificate). lean/docs/222.md lists only the Ising and spherical free-energy papers. proof_architecture.claim: Define the variational functional: Parisi-type pattern recursion V_f (equivalently Brownian control value) and entropy (Ising: dual of log cosh recursion; spherical: Crisanti-Sommers).
Order/regularity of V_f: first variations via tilted chain; L1 continuity; tail-integral order ⇒ V_f decreasing; Ising: concavity of ℓ and supporting inequality.
Overlap-array machinery: GG ⇒ positivity+ultrametricity; finite RPC law and marked transformation; residual per visit; fresh pattern evaluates to V_f(p).

Upper bound: enriched model (cascade label, hierarchical field, Poissonized density as time). Assume violation; minimize penalized contact objective; deterministic minimizer ⇒ joint GG ⇒ synchronization ⇒ field FOC gives tail(p) ≥ tail(q) ⇒ V_f(p) ≤ V_f(q), contradicting the time FOC which tends to -V_f(p)+V_f(q)+δ.

Lower bound, bulk: perturbation good sets; remove two patterns and restore them as independent cascade marks ⇒ gradient covariance B_N is deterministic a(R), diagonal a_d, correction c, with IBP balance c+a_d=∫ r a dμ; spherical: tangential divergence + Wronskian ⇒ a=A_q (stationary field), support < 1.

Lower bound, cavity: add L coordinates; Taylor expansion; evaluate increment L(ℓ(h)+½∫ph)+dV_f(p) (Ising) / via uniform spherical field formula (spherical); Ising dual attainment by coordinate exchangeability + concavity; telescope; L→∞.
Remove smoothness (Gaussian-L1 approximation, one-pattern deletion), concentration by bounded differences; Ising extensions (integrable, random signs).

Bi-orthogonal: condition on block norms (radial formula) → angular pressure → Gaussian Stiefel model with powered witness integral θ, matrix-path Parisi functional (contact upper bound + two-pattern cavity lower bound), Haar-shell majorization recovers the shell.

Jamming: concavity of row functional ⇒ pressure formula; mixture universality; repair ⇒ sharp threshold; zero temperature; convex martingale critical problem with uniqueness; endpoint scale estimates; rigidity of entire limits selects a_* (λ(a)=a); interval certificate encloses a_*; exponents γ=1-2a_*, θ=2a_*/(1-2a_*)-1.

eureka_candidates.lit_check: WebSearch 'negative spherical perceptron jamming exponents rigorous gap force' - only physics and capacity-bound papers (Stojnic, Montanari-Zhong-Zhou); no rigorous exponent result found.

correctness_audit.verdict: Strong-but-unreviewed. The spherical free-energy theorem (S) is the best-certified claim in this family: its full statement is a Lean comparator whose definitions are textually identical to the solution's and semantically faithful (no junk-value loophole found), with a 54k-line sorry/axiom-free DAG (compile status pending orchestrator). The Ising theorem rests on the paper alone (Lean certifies only the trivial finiteness clause), but its proof is a close parallel of S with an extra, carefully argued dual-attainment step. B is unformalized and its 'explicit' formula is a triple nested limit. J is a 10k-line unformalized paper whose exponent claim depends on a floating-point certificate.

Ising paper relies on the 2026 preprints chenissamourrat2026 and ho2026concavity for concavity but re-proves it (variational.tex:292-435), so no external dependency remains; the re-proof extends to repeated/zero levels by ε-perturbation (h_i+ε(i+1)) - looks fine.

No Lean.

Hard-constraint (zero-temperature, storage capacity) problems are explicitly out of scope of I/S/B; J treats only margin -1 with quadratic penalty.

extraction_friction: Four manuscripts with three different source layouts (sections/ + references.bib; paper.tex + bib; single 10k-line main.tex with inline bibliography and embedded Python listing).
Family has 3 Lean dirs (606 files, 130k lines); 2,651 declarations lie outside every comparator DAG (unfinished Ising formalization, duplicated SphericalField copies), inflating raw counts.

Same short lemma names in two namespaces (OAI.SphericalPerceptron vs OAI.SphericalPerceptronFreeEnergy) -> joins by name are ambiguous; Ising Lean also has an OAI.IsingPerceptron.Main sub-namespace for orphan upper-bound work.
Extractor's candidate-def ranking is uninformative here (max dominated share 0.001); per-target shares had to be recomputed from the `uses` graph.

B and J have no Lean; their candidates can only go to the informal list if ever graded N3.
